meta.name: pensieve-sync-to-main
meta.description: Sync Pensieve's Chinese development/release branch into the English main branch. Use in the Pensieve repository when the user asks to sync zh or experimental to main, publish the English branch, translate Pensieve README/tool specs/templates/SKILL.md, or run the zh-to-main release flow. Do not use for ordinary project localization or generic i18n.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将中文开发分支同步到英文主分支并翻译文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Pensieve仓库中同步中英文分支并翻译项目文档。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Chinese dev branch to English main and translate docs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to sync Chinese and English branches and translate project docs in the Pensieve repo.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在 Pensieve 仓库中，将中文开发或发布分支（zh 或 experimental）的变更同步到英文主分支（main），并自动翻译 README、SKILL.md 等文档中的中文内容为英文，同时保留贡献者历史。
howto.when: 当你在 Pensieve 仓库中要求同步 zh 或 experimental 到 main、发布英文分支、翻译相关文档或执行 zh-to-main 发布流程时触发。

say.text: 把 zh 分支同步到 main 并翻译文档。
say.note: Claude 会执行同步和翻译流程。

say.text: 将 experimental 分支合并到 main。
say.note: Claude 会合并并保留历史。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude syncs changes from the Chinese development/release branch (zh or experimental) to the English main branch in the Pensieve repository, automatically translating Chinese content in README, SKILL.md, and other specified files into English while preserving contributor history.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to sync zh or experimental to main, publish the English branch, translate Pensieve documents, or run the zh-to-main release flow in the Pensieve repository.

say_en.text: Sync the zh branch to main and translate the docs.
say_en.note: Claude will perform the sync and translation.

say_en.text: Merge the experimental branch into main.
say_en.note: Claude will merge and preserve history.
